a.lede: AMD has admitted a bug within its External Events Utility is wearing out SSDs, and promises a fix.
a.title: AMD confirms GPU driver bug is wearing out your SSD – how to stop it

b.lede: AMD is investigating reports that its External Events Utility generates continuous SSD writes of up to 5MB/s, even when Radeon-powered PCs are idle. Users have also reported declining SSD health, while potential workarounds come with performance trade-offs
b.title: AMD admits GPU driver bug is writing data continuously, wearing out SSDs
